title: Chat Titler
description: Names each chat with the model after a completed turn, once however many windows are open

settings.label: Title chats automatically
settings.desc: after a completed turn, while the chat still has its first-message title

settings.label: Re-title as the chat grows
settings.desc: look again after later turns too (a title you set by hand is never touched)

settings.label: Title length
settings.desc: longer titles are cut at a word

settings.label: Provider
settings.desc: provider entry for the title call; empty = the chat's own

settings.label: Model
settings.desc: model id for the title call; empty = the chat's own

settings.label: Reasoning effort
settings.desc: for the title call, on providers that send one; empty = the provider's own

settings.label: Debug notices
settings.desc: notify each title, and why a chat was skipped
